text:
jamie: Heads-up: found parity issue between Node SDK and REST for batch generation — SDK ignores custom headers (x-redwood-client) and uses batch_size param name 'batchSize' but REST expects 'batch_size'. Also seeing auth retry mismatch: REST triggers a token refresh on 401, Node SDK currently does not.
sarah: Thanks, can you paste a small repro and which SDK version?
jamie: Here's minimized repro (Node v14, sdk@1.2.4):

```
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generateBatch({ model: 'redwood-v1', batchSize: 8 }, { headers: { 'x-redwood-client': 'internal-tool' } });
```

// observed: header not forwarded; REST curl with same headers works; and batchSize param is not translated to batch_size.
mike: I can repro locally, looks like our request sanitizer lower-cases then strips unknown headers. Also the param mapper only runs on top-level body keys, looks like batchSize is nested in generateBatch wrapper so mapping missed it.
sarah: I'll open a patch to stop stripping unknown headers and add a camelCase->snake_case mapper for generateBatch payloads. Temporary workaround: call the REST endpoint directly with body: { model: 'redwood-v1', batch_size: 8 } and set headers manually.
jamie: Also 401 retry: SDK retry middleware only treats 429/5xx as retryable. We should treat 401 specially to trigger token refresh + retry. Filing an issue in infra.
mike: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1427 — assigned to sarah, branch node/fix-header-batch
sarah: Working on tests. Will add a unit test that asserts headers are present and an integration test against the api-mock to prevent future drift. Also adding 401->refresh path to retry middleware.
devex-bot: Canary for node sdk v1.2.5-alpha deployed to test runners with header passthrough fix.
jamie: Confirmed canary fixes headers but batch_size mapping still broken. Will re-run suite tomorrow. :thumbsup:
